t: This is The Bull, a Grade II* listed sculpture on Daneburry Avenue in Roehampton. It is by Robert Clatworthy, who lived from 1928 to 2015 and worked as a sculptor, painter and teacher of art. He headed the fine art department at the Central School of Art and Design in London from 1971 to 1975, and was elected to the Royal Academy in 1973. The Grade II* listing marks the work out as particularly important, so take a moment to walk around it and look at the animal's form.
